scope: Generated low-level PARTIALVIEWINGINDEX DXF serialization, identity binding, indexed-target closure, rollback and typed readback.

behavior: The record's group-5 identity is source-remapped and reserved, or allocated when the source handle is absent; source identities bind only after successful record serialization.
Each entry validates finite extents and a nonzero, nonsentinel group-340 source handle before record emission.
The configured reference resolver takes precedence and returns the final output identity; otherwise the source-handle remap is used.
A group-340 target is emitted only when its final handle occurs exactly once in the writer inventory and the source handle has a matching unambiguous typed entity, object, or table identity binding.

The record is staged with DxfWriterRecordScope and RecordStateScope so late serialization failures roll back bytes and source identity-map changes; the focused corrected retry uses a fresh writer after the failed direct writer is poisoned.

validationProfile.source: Locally constructed in-memory AC1032 DXF records. No DWG/DXF fixture files were added.
cases: allocated group-5 identity when no source identity is present
group-340 remap fallback to an already-emitted POINT identity
resolver final identity overrides a conflicting fallback remap
refusal of missing nonzero, zero, and DRW::NoHandle targets
refusal when a resolver aliases another emitted record without source identity proof
late invalid XDATA failure preserves prior output and rolls back the PVI identity
typed PARTIALVIEWINGINDEX callback readback of identity, extents, and reference

limitations: Generated transport and writer-inventory closure only; no eligible physical PARTIALVIEWINGINDEX producer/source-span profile is established.
The source map proves a broad typed entity/object/table identity path but does not independently establish the indexed target's exact format role or owner semantics.

No native consumer interpretation, complete document graph closure, or support claim is qualified. Keep the adapter gate fail-closed until source, role/owner, and composed readback evidence is available.
